scope: One fresh Chromium 390x844 R96 flow. Playwright taps only through ordinary UI: idle opening, assisted repeat taps, idle third memory, and retry. Browser click to first changed runner position via requestAnimationFrame. Excludes app load and leading story page tap. This is neither a touch-to-display measurement nor a player study.
